TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Telemetry is disabled by default and keeps JSON tracing on stderr only.
telemetry.enabled=true without the cargo feature falls back to stderr tracing with a warning.
With the telemetry feature, OTLP exporter initialization uses configured endpoint, service name, sampling, batch interval, and resource attributes.
TelemetryGuard shutdown flushes the SDK provider when OTLP export was enabled.
Sampler parsing accepts always_on, always_off, and ratio:0..1 values while rejecting invalid ratios.
